bio: Set within the Park Hyatt hotel, this upscale American tavern boasts a sleek, urbane and dreamily sprawling interior, with soaring windows, walnut wood seating and highly coveted glass-enclosed booths. Whether dining in the plush room or expansive lounge—which features a separate cheese- and charcuterie-focused carte—the gorgeous space and its well-to-do crowd are the epitome of casual sophistication. Similarly, the product-driven menu has an all-American sensibility, highlighting farms and purveyors. At the center of the open kitchen sits a behemoth wood-burning oven that turns out such classics as whole-roasted fish or the popular duck leg confit. Don't forget to peruse their dessert station and impressive tea list with nearly 30 teas of different levels, including the rare 1985 Emperor'...
